headline: Bengaluru Couple Killed in Crash
summary: A Bengaluru couple died following a car-truck collision at Dharbandora. They were reportedly on a trip to drop their sister-in-law to Goa when the fatal accident occurred.

headline: Goa Acquires Ancient Sculpture
summary: Goa has acquired a 16th-century Kalbhairav sculpture from Mandrem. The historic artifact was successfully secured for the state.

headline: AAP Promotes Guarantees
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has taken its six key guarantees to households across Goa. Women across the state have also expressed support for AAP's monthly financial assistance promise during meetings.

headline: Fisheries Policy Guidance
summary: GRE representatives stated that Matanhy's legacy must guide Goa's fisheries policy. They emphasized honoring past principles for sustainable development in the sector.

headline: Domestic Flight Departures to Drop
summary: Goa's daily domestic flight departures are set to drop by 12% in November. This comes amid a broader reported nosedive in air traffic across Goa airports.

headline: Fatal Trip for Bengaluru Pair
summary: A trip to drop a relative off in Goa turned fatal for a Bengaluru man and his wife following a severe collision. Both succumbed to their injuries after the accident.

headline: S Goa Collector Issues Mutation SOP
summary: The South Goa collector has issued a standard operating procedure (SOP) for mutation cases. Meanwhile, advocates have flagged missing officials and files at mutation camps.

headline: GCCI Seeks GST Reforms
summary: The Goa Chamber of Commerce and Industry has called for simpler GST compliance and reforms to support state MSMEs. They also pledged industry support to help build a knowledge economy under the new AI policy.

headline: Goa Eyes Mud Crab Farming Model
summary: Goa is looking at the Andhra Pradesh model to boost local mud crab farming. The initiative aims to enhance aquaculture practices in the region.

headline: Ethan Vaz Becomes Grandmaster
summary: Goa's Ethan Vaz has achieved the milestone of becoming India's 96th Grandmaster. He earned widespread praise for his exceptional performance in chess.

headline: Air Traffic Nosedives in Goa
summary: Air traffic across Goa airports has experienced a sharp decline. This downward trend coincides with a projected drop in domestic flight departures for the upcoming month.

headline: Mother and Son Found Dead
summary: A mother and her son were found dead in the Terekhol River. Local authorities launched an investigation into the tragic incident.

headline: Sardesai Flags Voter Rules Confusion
summary: Goa Forward Party leader Sardesai has highlighted booth-level officers' lack of clarity regarding voter enrolment rules. He urged authorities to address the administrative confusion promptly.

headline: Two Arrested in Investment Fraud
summary: The Goa Cyber Crime Cell arrested two Maharashtra men in connection with a Rs 39 lakh online investment scam. Police hailed it as a major breakthrough against digital fraudsters.

headline: Kamat Focuses on Margao Development
summary: Politician Digambar Kamat has shifted focus toward local development initiatives as he prepares for upcoming polls to retain Margao. He emphasized continued civic progress.

headline: Child Drowns in Resort Pool
summary: A naval officer's five-year-old son tragically drowned in a South Goa resort pool. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the drowning.

headline: GCCI Hails Goa AI Policy
summary: The GCCI praised the Goa AI Policy 2026, stating it will drive economic growth and foster a knowledge economy. The government also launched related tech initiatives and hackathons.

headline: Sattari Turmeric Yield to Drop
summary: Sattari's turmeric production is expected to fall by up to 40% due to poor rainfall. Farmers anticipate a challenging season following inadequate monsoon showers.

headline: Candolim Residents Demand Safety
summary: Villagers in Candolim have raised safety concerns regarding ongoing GSIDC work sites in their area. They have urged authorities to take immediate precautionary measures.

headline: House Gutted in Cylinder Blast
summary: A house in Bhoma was completely gutted following an LPG cylinder blast. Fire and emergency services responded to the incident.

headline: Archives Department Seeks Translators
summary: Goa's archives department is planning to rope in Portuguese translators. The initiative aims to help process and study historical documents more effectively.

headline: GSPCB Flags Eateries Loophole
summary: The Goa State Pollution Control Board has pointed out a regulatory loophole that leaves most local eateries outside its direct oversight. Officials are reviewing steps to address the gap.

headline: Natural Farming Push in Villages
summary: The Khet Bachao Abhiyan has launched a natural farming outreach campaign for rural villagers. The initiative promotes chemical-free agricultural practices across local communities.

headline: Punjab Defeats Churchill Brothers
summary: Punjab secured a late victory to upset Churchill Brothers in a competitive football fixture. The Goan side conceded crucial goals in the closing stages of the match.

headline: Road Accidents Claim Three Lives
summary: Three people died and five others were injured in multiple accidents along the Khanapur and Goa road sections. Emergency responders rushed the injured to nearby hospitals.

headline: Health Minister Inspects Home Care
summary: Goa's health minister visited patients to personally assess the delivery of home-based healthcare support services. The initiative aims to ensure effective medical care for residents at home.

headline: Lupin Goa Facility Gets US FDA Note
summary: Pharmaceutical major Lupin received a single observation following a US FDA inspection at its Goa manufacturing facility. The company is addressing the regulatory feedback.

headline: Woman Dies After Scooter Crash
summary: A woman succumbed to her injuries days after being involved in a scooter accident in Mandrem. Local authorities registered the case as an accident death.

headline: Goa Launches AI Policy 2026
summary: The Goa government officially unveiled its AI Policy 2026 alongside a state hackathon and an AI Centre of Excellence. Officials emphasized turning tech vision into actionable growth.

headline: Goa Targets Innovation Ecosystem
summary: Goa aims to build a robust, innovation-driven AI ecosystem and announced the return of its tech conclave next year. Leaders highlighted the state's readiness for digital transformation.

headline: New Tender for CoP Terminal
summary: A fresh tender is currently in the works for the Mormugao Port's ship-shaped terminal project. Authorities are working to expedite the pending infrastructure development.

headline: Uncertainty Over ST Political Quota
summary: Political reservation quotas for scheduled tribes in Goa remain shrouded in uncertainty. Community leaders continue to seek clarity from authorities.

headline: Davorlim FC Wins Football Tourney
summary: Davorlim FC clinched the championship title in the inaugural All Goa Football Tournament. They triumphed over rival teams to lift the trophy.

headline: Harvalem Project Faces Land Dispute
summary: A temple land controversy has created obstacles for the Harvalem development project. Local stakeholders are attempting to resolve the ownership and usage issues.

headline: Govt Ready to Acquire Chimbel Site
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant announced that the Goa government is ready to acquire the historic 1928 Shuddhikaran site at Chimbel. The move aims to preserve an important piece of local heritage.

headline: Virat Kohli's Investment Portfolio
summary: Cricketer Virat Kohli's diverse business portfolio includes investments in gym chains, FC Goa, and apparel brands. His business ventures continue to expand across multiple sectors.

headline: Curchorem Citizens Raise Grievances
summary: Residents at a Curchorem public meeting flagged persistent civic issues and pending land matters. They urged local representatives to take swift corrective action.

headline: Board Plans Quarry Restoration
summary: The Goa Biodiversity Board has formulated plans to restore 20 abandoned laterite quarries across the state. The ecological project aims to rehabilitate damaged landscapes.

headline: Goa Notifies Acid Attack Rehab
summary: The Goa government has officially notified a comprehensive rehabilitation scheme for acid attack survivors. The program provides financial aid, medical care, and support services.

headline: Cyberfrauds Persist in South Goa
summary: Despite growing public awareness campaigns, cyber frauds continue to thrive in South Goa. Police have urged citizens to remain vigilant against online scams.

headline: Book Wisdom Inspires Society
summary: Dr. Madgaonkar noted that the wisdom found in 'Bhaktigeet Sagar' continues to guide the human mind and society. The literary work was praised for its moral teachings.
